title: Here’s what the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max could look like
description: We’ve heard plenty about the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max in recent weeks. The flagship is said to launch in China this month with a triple 200MP rear camera setup. Ahead of any official announcement, leaked renders of the phone have now surfaced. The leaked renders, shared by tipster Fixed Focus Digital, show a redesigned rear camera module that now stretches across the width of the device. It’s somewhat similar to the iPhone 17 Pro’s camera plateau. However, the Find X10 Pro Max features a second square module positioned within the larger rectangular camera island. The inner module...

title: Huawei Watch GT 7 Pro in for review
description: This is the Huawei Watch GT 7 Pro in Pine Green, and we’re taking a closer look at it ahead of our full review. Let’s start with the unboxing experience. Huawei is still using its proprietary magnetic charging puck, which is wired to a USB-A cable. That’s the only accessory you get in the package. We were hoping for a detachable USB-C connector by now, but there’s always next year. The overall design of the GT 7 Pro is quite similar to the GT 6 Pro, though there are some subtle changes. The first one is the new screen bezel, which is color-matched to the watch strap. Speaking...

title: Huawei MatePad Pro 12 (2026) goes global
description: Huawei held a big event in Munich where we got to see its latest wearables as well as the global debut of the nova16s series smartphones. But those weren’t the only devices to take the stage, as the MatePad Pro 12 (2026) also made its global debut. The tablet was announced in China last month and brings 12-inch OLED with 3,036 × 1,952px resolution, a 144Hz refresh rate and 1,600 nits peak brightness. Huawei is also offering a PaperMatte Display version of the tablet, which features an anti-glare coating. Huawei is also offering two optional accessories with the M-Pencil Pro stylus and...

title: Huawei nova 16s Pro goes global with 200MP RYYB camera, nova 16s joins it
description: Huawei introduced the nova 16 and 16 Pro to the Chinese market at the start of June. These two are now ready for their global debut, kind of – as has become the norm for the company, the global versions get an “s” tagged on to their name. The Huawei nova 16s Pro preserves the Pro’s highlight – a 200MP RYYB sensor for the main camera (f/1.8 lens with OIS). This is helped out by a 1.5MP multi-spectral sensor for scene-specific color calibration. Also on the back are a 50MP RYYB 3.7x periscope (f/2.6 lens with OIS) and a 50MP RYYB ultra-wide (118° FoV, 2.5cm macro mode). The selfie camera...

title: Huawei Watch 6 series announced, Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro go global
description: Huawei unveiled its latest smartwatches with the Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro slotting in as the new flagship wearables from the brand. They are joined by the Watch GT 7 and Watch GT 7 Pro which were previously announced in China as well as the Watch D3 and FreeBuds Neo with the latter two covered in a separate post. Huawei Watch 6 and 6 Pro The Huawei Watch 6 series consists of two members with the Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro. The vanilla Watch 6 arrives in 42 and 46mm sizes, while the Pro is offered in 43 and 46mm casings. The 42mm Watch 6 comes in at just 38 grams (without the strap), making...

title: Huawei Watch D3 and FreeBuds Neo debut
description: The Watch 6 and Watch GT 7 series are Huawei’s mainstream smartwatches, but the brand also introduced the latest addition to its health-focused Watch D series with the Watch D3. It brings medical-grade blood pressure monitoring, an updated design with а larger and brighter display. Alongside its new wrist wearables, Huawei also announced a new pair of wireless earbuds dubbed FreeBuds Neo. Huawei Watch D3 On the outside, Watch D3 looks a lot like its predecessor, though Huawei managed to slim the aluminum chassis down to 11.3 mm while keeping the weight at 40 grams. Huawei...

title: Samsung is building Exynos 2700-powered Galaxy S27 Ultras, insiders claim
description: Samsung may be changing course at the 11th hour – development of the Galaxy S27 Ultra is nearly complete, but now insiders are saying that the company will dual-source chipsets for the new flagship. The original plan was for the S27 Ultra to use the top Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip in all markets. However, following encouraging internal benchmarks, the Exynos 2700 has become a viable option for the 2027 flagship. The insiders quoted by Korean publication MoneyToday claim that Samsung MX and LSI have coordinated to develop an Exynos-based motherboard for the S27 Ultra and to ensure a...

title: The Huawei MatePad Air (2026) is launching in China next week, may bring some upgrades
description: Reversing the traditional dynamic, the Huawei MatePad Air (2026) was announced for the global market back in July and will only launch in China next week on September 7 (Monday). This will happen at the event for the tri-folding Huawei Mate XT 2. The Huawei MatePad Air (2026) is launching in China next week The MatePad Air (2026) is a 12” tablet with a 144Hz OLED display – a 3:2 2,800 x 1,840px panel. Huawei’s PaperMatte technology is an optional upgrade – this cuts down on reflections and reduces interference from ambient light (and it costs extra). The tablet is powered by...

title: Samsung Galaxy S24 series owners surprisingly get One UI 9 beta update too
description: Samsung expanded the Android 17-based One UI 9 Beta program to six Galaxy devices yesterday, including Galaxy Z Fold7, Galaxy Z Flip7, Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25+, Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Galaxy S25 FE. It also released the One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy S25 series yesterday. Now, in a surprising move, the Korean company has rolled out One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S24 series as well. [#InlinePriceWidget,13322,1#] The One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy S24, Galaxy S24+, and Galaxy S24 Ultra is available in the US, India, and South Korea. The update weighs around 3.6GB and has a firmware...

title: vivo T5 5G unveiled: Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, 144Hz curved display, and 7,050 mAh battery
description: vivo launched the T5 4G in May, and as promised, the company unveiled the T5 5G today, making it the sixth member of the T5 series. vivo says the T5 5G is "designed for ambitious young hustlers who seek powerful performance, premium design and long-lasting endurance." The vivo T5 5G is powered by the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, paired with up to 12GB of LPDDR4X RAM. It has up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage onboard and runs Android 16-based OriginOS 6 out of the box. vivo has promised three Android OS upgrades and five years of security updates for the T5 5G. The vivo T5 5G has a 6.83" 3D...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold gets its first official look ahead of September 7 launch
description: Xiaomi confirmed last week that its wide-screen foldable will launch in September with the Xring O3 chipset. Now, the company has officially revealed the Xiaomi 18 Fold’s design and confirmed its launch date. The Xiaomi 18 Fold will launch in China on September 7, two days before Apple is expected to unveil its own wide-screen foldable, the iPhone Ultra. Alongside announcing the launch date, Xiaomi also showcased the foldable in a Nishino Red colorway. The phone is seen with a triple rear camera setup and an LED flash housed inside a horizontal, pill-shaped camera module. It also...

title: Oukitel has a rugged industrial tablet, a laptop with a solar panel and home solar batteries
description: In addition to its rugged phones – check them out here – Oukitel unveiled an 11” industrial tablet, a laptop with a solar panel on it and several solar energy solutions for the home and the campsite. Oukitel RT10 series tablets The Oukitel RT10 is an 11” industrial tablet with a fingerprint scanner and a 2D barcode scanner. It has a 1080p 120Hz display and 5W stereo speakers rated for over 130dB. The tablet is powered by the Dimensity 7400X (12GB RAM, 512GB storage, expandable) and a 25,000mAh battery. Oukitel RT10 industrial tablet The industrial version supports...

title: Oukitel unveils a gaming phone with dual fan cooling, a phone with a built-in lighter and more
description: Oukitel arrived at IFA with suitcases full of rugged hardware. There’s a rugged gaming phone, an “ultra-endurance” flagship and even a phone that has a built-in electric lighter. Oukitel WP70 Ultra The Oukitel WP70 Ultra claims to be the slimmest phone with a 16,000mAh battery. The massive silicon-carbon battery supports 66W fast charging. This phone has a 6.78” 120Hz OLED display and is powered by the Dimensity 7200 chipset (this was MediaTek’s first 4nm chipset). The phone launches with Android 16 out of the box. Oukitel WP70 Ultra in: Green • Purple • Orange There is...

title: Apple’s foldable iPhone Ultra said to feature MagSafe charging
description: Apple is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone, rumored to be called the iPhone Ultra, at its September 9 event. Ahead of the launch, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has revealed details about its features and pricing in an interview with Tom’s Guide. In the interview, Gurman also says that the upcoming iPhone Ultra will likely support MagSafe charging, despite leaked renders and dummy units not showing the familiar magnetic ring. Alleged iPhone Ultra (left) dummy doesn't show magnetic ring for MagSafe Gurman believes Apple will be able to include the feature because it managed to...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 and S27+ bag 3C certification, charging speeds revealed
description: Samsung’s upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup has been the subject of several leaks in recent weeks. Now, the base Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ have appeared on China’s 3C certification website, revealing details about their charging capabilities. According to the 3C listing, the Galaxy S27, carrying the model number SM-S9520, will support 25W wired charging. This is the same charging speed offered by its predecessor, the Galaxy S26, as well as the Galaxy S20, which launched several years ago. Meanwhile, the Galaxy S27+ with model number SM-S9560 is listed with support for 45W wired charging....

title: Google announces September Android drop, here are all the new features
description: Today Google has announced its September Android drop, which incorporates five new features coming to Android devices left and right. So let's dive right in. You will "soon" be able to ask Gemini to remember where you put important items and it will save their location in Google's Find Hub so you can easily find them later. This is intended for things you don't put a tracker tag on, like your passport or a spare key. Just tell Gemini where the item is - or maybe add an optional photo. When you need to find it, either ask Gemini for its location or check the remembered items tab in Find...

title: nubia's NaviX Ultra AI phone is coming this month
description: Back in July, nubia first talked about the NaviX Ultra, an "AI-powered smartphone" because nubia didn't want to let a company you've probably never heard of claim that title all by itself. Now the nubia NaviX Ultra has been certified in China by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) - or rather, its built-in AI Large Language Model (LLM) got the green light (as all AI models have to in China, by law). The phone was jointly developed by nubia and ByteDance, the company behind TikTok. It will be available in four colors: blue, black, white, and "Dream". nubia...

title: Poco F9 Pro in for review
description: Looking at the Poco F9 Pro, you'd be forgiven for not wanting an F9 Ultra. Yes, global users are getting a big battery reduction - the Redmi K100 Pro, on which the Poco F9 Pro is based, has a whopper of a battery at 8,580mAh, while the Poco makes do with 6,330mAh. But it's still not bad at all. In the hands, the Poco F9 Pro is a premium-feeling smartphone. It's glass on both sides and brushed metal in the middle. It's also a comfortable slab to handle for long periods, thanks to its reasonably sized 6.59-inch display. A key difference between the Poco F9 Pro and its Ultra...

title: vivo X500 Pro series video capabilities teased ahead of launch
description: vivo recently began teasing its upcoming X500 series and has already confirmed several key camera features of the X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. The company has now offered a glimpse at the video capabilities of its upcoming Pro models. Last week, vivo confirmed that the X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max will support 4K 240fps slow-motion video recording. The phones will feature a new primary rear camera that uses a custom Phantom 900 sensor co-developed by Sony and vivo’s Blueprint Imaging team. vivo also confirmed that the new sensor offers up to 17EV of dynamic range and 3-axis optical...

title: Google Pics launches to create and edit images in Google Docs, Slides, and Drive
description: Today Google is starting to make Google Pics available. Google Pics is a new service that is not to be confused with Google Photos or Google Images. Google Pics is billed by Google as providing you with "a suite of fine-tuned editing capabilities that let you generate images and make precise edits rather than starting from scratch". Why this couldn't just be a Gemini feature is unclear. It is also using Nano Banana, although Google doesn't say which version. Pics is both a standalone product and integrated into Google Workspace apps, starting with Slides, Docs, and Drive, so it will...
